title: Keep a growing list
summary: Go: Keep a growing list. Append 9 too. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: A slice is a view of a list of values. append returns a slice with more items.
learningObjectives: Keep a growing list with Go

blocks.text: Install Go 1.22 or later. Save one complete example as lesson.go and run go run lesson.go.

blocks.title: Keep a growing list

blocks.text: append returns a slice with 8 added. Assignment keeps that returned slice.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Keep the slice returned by append.
